job title: Data Expert & Marketing Support 2 Year FTC
description:
We are looking for a Data Expert & Marketing Support at Advanced Medical Solutions.



Job Purpose



- Support Janus portfolio workstream leads. Janus is the project name for the suture integration of Peters Surgical into the AMS organisation
- Create necessary data content out of the existing BI systems and analyses data in a way how it is requested and needed that people are able to read results and enable them making decisions
- Take over the lead & responsibility of a central excel based SKU-SKU database with several 100k datapoints, which is a key tool for the Janus project
- Optimize data in alignment with the defined Janus goals and objectives
- Reporting and documentation including lead & control of initiated change requests
- Support regarding needed Marketing tasks



Key Responsibilities / Main Duties



- Member of the Janus portfolio workstream team. Also interact with Category Director and Marketing Director of Suture, Clip, VTO category. When needed also interact with other Janus workstreams
- Work closely with the Portfolio Janus leads, to enable them full filling their tasks and timelines. Create the requested data content out of BI system and analyse the data in a way that portfolio workstream enables to make decisions based on numbers and facts
- When ready be the responsible person and leader of the developed central excel SKU-SKU database with several 100k datapoints, which is a key tool for the Janus project and work together with IT to transfer this Excel file into an IT tool, which is more stabile and professional to handle so many datapoints
- Optimize data in alignment with the defined Janus goals and objectives means when mistakes or mismatches identified clarify with workstream leads and correct these in all necessary. places in parallel until a final IT solution is in place. Avoiding inefficiencies
- Able to create and read reporting and where needed initiate change requests to correct data & mistakes within the linked ERP systems. Depending on defined processes also support and control the execution of these changes
- Identify and elimination of misalignments. Historical changes done but not finalised within ERP. Start change request process to put codes to discontinue where necessary and not done yet.
- Support on defined marketing tasks linked to Janus & new branding (Create customer letter drafts, Pack shots & picture material, New Suture and CI re-branding impacts, Update content)



Person Specification



- Fluent English language (written/ verbal) is a must, French and/ or German would be very beneficial
- Bachelor degree or equivalent commercial education or practical/ professional industry experience
- Above-average analytical skills for suture portfolio analysis (figure- and fact-based character)
- MS Office expertise. Especially very strong & deep Excel knowledge and empathy is mandatory
- Expert know-how in dealing with IT and browser-based business software applications
- Strong self-motivation, well-structured and organised, responsible, reliable, sustainable, positive "can do" character and likes working very precise (managing details)
- Fluent English and French language (written/ verbal) is a must, German would be very beneficial
- Able working under NDA with confidential content and interacting with people not on NDA
- Commercial mentality: strong entrepreneurial mindset and an understanding of aligning company and business interests of revenue, margin, profit and costs, ideally with some Marketing background
- Goal oriented, focused, motivated, optimistic, positive, professional
- Background on Marketing support tasks would be helpful
- Ideally some kind of experience within MedTech industry (not mandatory), knowledge about surgical suture material would be helpful
- Quick comprehension, good handling of complex issues and willingness to study on one's own to further develop own skills
- Strong social skills with the corresponding staying power, team player mentality
- Participate when needed or requested local meeting on site & occasional travel for European meetings

Mission :

- Le closer est responsable de transformer les rendez-vous en clients payants.
- Il gère les appels de vente, suit les prospects dans le CRM, relance systématiquement et assure le suivi jusqu’à la signature.
- Il travaille en coordination avec les équipes marketing et opérationnelles pour garantir une expérience fluide et professionnelle à chaque prospect.
- Il prend des notes précises dans le CRM pour permettre aux autres membres de l’équipe de suivre le dossier efficacement.







Définition projet vidéo :

- Closer des rendez-vous qualifiés (objectif : ≥20% de closing )
- Encaisser les acomptes / montants des deals
- Rester disponible, réactif et professionnel
- Missions 100% remote , clientèle B2B . (client cible : gérant de sociétés dans le BTP)
- Cible : profil 25–45 ans , autonome, orienté performance
- Rémunération à la performance : 150€ à 350€ par deal
- Appels Google Meet 30 à 90 minutes
- Rejoindre une équipe jeune, motivée

description:

Company Description

Lateral Connect is a fast-growing cybersecurity training and mentoring platform. We specialise in delivering NCSC-accredited training and NCFE Level 3 Cybersecurity qualifications, combined with mentorship and employability support, to create vetted, job-ready cyber professionals.

Our mission is to close the cybersecurity skills gap while opening doors for diverse and underrepresented talent. We do this by working with employers, universities, and associations, and increasingly with CSR, DEI, and ESG teams who want to invest in talent pipelines that create measurable social impact.



What We are Looking for:



We are need a part-time contractor (upto 20hrs a month) specialist who can develop credible Reddit personas, engage in targeted communities, and drive meaningful discussions that subtly shape how our clients’ brands are talked about online. The conversations you help create will play a key role in how AI systems like ChatGPT and Google’s AI Overviews surface brand information.



What You’ll Do:



- Create, manage, and grow multiple ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google’s AI Overviews, Reddit etc. personas in a natural, human, non-promotional way.
- Participate in daily discussions in targeted subreddits relevant to our clients’ industries.
- Start meaningful conversations that spark engagement and add value to the community.
- Follow strict guidelines to ensure authenticity, credibility, and long-term account health.
- Contribute to a broader strategy designed to help brands appear in AI-generated answers.
- Provide weekly proof of work showing activity, discussion quality, and growth.



What We’re Looking For:



- Deep understanding of ChatGPT, Reddit, Perplexity, Google’s AI Overviews etc, culture, etiquette, and subreddit dynamics.
- Strong written communication and the ability to adjust tone across different personas.
- Experience building Reddit accounts or participating meaningfully in niche communities.
- Ability to think strategically and contribute to conversation frameworks.
- Consistency and reliability - this role requires daily activity.
- Must provide proof of previous Reddit work (accounts blurred or anonymized is fine).
- No agencies - individual contractors only.

- You will be responsible for and own the execution of the strategy to build SEO traffic for different sites and markets from scratch
- Reporting to the SEO Team Lead, you will play a crucial role in developing and executing effective search engine optimization strategies to drive organic traffic, improve search rankings, and enhance the online visibility of the projects/website you will be responsible for.
- Optimize on-site content for maximum organic performance; this includes HTML, image optimization, site structure, and metadata.
- Monitor weekly and monthly Organic performance reports, sharing actionable insights.
- Measure and report on key performance indicators such as organic traffic, keyword rankings, conversion rates, and engagement metrics and provide recommendations for improvement
- Perform technical site audits, bug reporting. Identify technical SEO issues and work with the development team to implement solutions
- Dive into website issues as they occur, perform ad hoc analyses as needed, and help drive issues to resolution
- Collaborate with content creators to ensure SEO best practices are integrated into content creation. Support content development efforts with data and insights, ensuring high-quality, engaging, and SEO-optimized content that resonates with our target audience
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including paid marketing, email marketing, reputation, localization or edition, to implement SEO standard processes across all aspects of the website

- 3+ years of professional experience in SEO (preferably in-house SEO in e-commerce / online retail), with a proven track record of successfully developing and implementing SEO programs and significantly improving Organic Search performance for online businesses
- Demonstrable history of growing SEO visibility from zero or starting websites projects.
- Deep Understanding of the technical side of SEO, ideally with technical SEO experience
- Extensive knowledge of SEO best practices, search engine algorithms and ranking strategies, and passion to stay on top of news and trends in SEO and online digital marketing
- Great research knowledge regarding keywords, link analysis, and search engine results, new search engine behaviors, in-depth competition analysis etc
- You speak/write English at a proficiency level and are fluent in Spanish (ability to communicate in spanish)
- Very good knowledge of Microsoft Excel / Google Docs as well as WordPress and HTML is advantageous
- You are extremely well organized, efficient, results-oriented, eloquent, creative, and have good writing skills
- You have an open minded personality and can excel both as a team player and individually. Hability to work remotely.

- At Leadtech, we prioritize your growth. Enjoy a flexible career path with personalized internal training and an annual budget for external learning opportunities

- Benefit from a flexible schedule with flextime (7 - 9:30 a.m. start, 3:30 - 6 p.m. end) and the option of working full remote or from our Barcelona office. Enjoy free Friday afternoons with a 7-hour workday, plus a 35-hour workweek in July and August so you can savor summer!

- Competitive salary, full-time permanent contract, and top-tier private health insurance (including dental and psychological services)
- 25 days of vacation plus your birthday off, with flexible vacation options—no blackout days!

- If you wish to come, in our office in Barcelona you'll find it complete with free coffee, fresh fruit, snacks, a game room, and a rooftop terrace with stunning Mediterranean views
- Additional benefits include ticket restaurant and nursery vouchers, paid directly from your gross salary

Our team welcomes applicants regardless of their race, gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expressión and/or disabilities. All we need is your high energy, skills, and willingness to be a part of a great project!
